company.introduction: ธนาคารไทยพาณิชย์ (Siam Commercial Bank of Thailand) เป็นธนาคารไทยแห่งแรก ก่อตั้งขึ้นโดยพระบรมราชานุญาตเมื่อวันที่ 30 มกราคม 2449 ตลอดระยะเวลาอันยาวนาน มีบทบาทสำคัญในการให้บริการทางการเงินในประเทศไทยผ่านวัฎจักรเศรษฐกิจมากมาย ก่อให้เกิดความเชี่ยวชาญอย่างต่อเนื่อง ณ วันนี้ ธนาคารไทยพาณิชย์ เป็นธนาคารที่ให้บริการทางการเงินครบวงจรชั้นนำของประเทศ นำเสนอผลิตภัณฑ์และบริการที่หลากหลาย นอกเหนือจากบริการเงินรับฝากและ ธุรกรรมที่เกี่ยวกับการให้สินเชื่อ เพื่อตอบสนองต่อความต้องการของลูกค้าทุกกลุ่ม ในส่วนของลูกค้าบุคคล ธนาคารให้บริการสินเชื่อที่อยู่อาศัย สินเชื่อส่วนบุคคล สินเชื่อเช่าซื้อรถยนต์ บริการบัตรเครดิต บัตรเดบิต บริการแลกเปลี่ยนเงินตราต่างประเทศ บริการโอนเงินทั้งใน ประเทศและต่างประเทศ รวมถึงผลิตภัณฑ์เพื่อการลงทุนและ การประกัน สำหรับลูกค้าธุรกิจ ธนาคารให้บริการที่เกี่ยวข้องกับการบริหารเงินเพื่อธุรกิจ ผลิตภัณฑ์สินเชื่อการค้าต่างประเทศ ผลิตภัณฑ์ บริหารเงิน ผลิตภัณฑ์ทางตลาดตราสารหนี้ และตลาดทุน บริการที่ปรึกษาทางการเงิน วาณิชธนกิจ รวมถึง บริการทางการเงินอื่น ๆ พร้อมด้วยเครือข่ายการให้บริการที่กว้างขวางและครอบคลุม สอดรับกับการเติบโตของโลกที่ก้าวหน้าอย่างไม่หยุดยั้ง นอกจากนี้ธนาคารมีบริษัทในเครือที่สำคัญ ซึ่งให้บริการทางการเงินเพื่อตอบสนองความต้องการเฉพาะของลูกค้า ได้แก่ บริษัทหลักทรัพย์ ไทยพาณิชย์ จำกัด และบริษัทหลักทรัพย์จัดการกองทุน ไทยพาณิชย์

rows.title: Data Scientist - SCB Digital Banking
rows.description:
What you will do:


  • Apply statistical and machine learning methods to large, complex data sets to draw insights and provide actionable recommendations
  • Solve complex problems on both technical and business sides using advanced analytical methods
  • Work with Engineering teams to implement end-to-end process from model development to testing, validation, and deployment
  • Research and develop new quantitative models and frameworks to enhance the company’s data science capability


Basic Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Math, Physics, Statistics or other areas that are highly quantitative
  • Experience with statistical programming languages (e.g., Python, R, pandas) and database software (e.g., SQL, PySpark)
  • Knowledge in statistics (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression) and machine learning
  • Strong analytical problem-solving capabilities
  • Master’s or PhD degree in a quantitative discipline
  • Experience applying machine learning and statistical methods to large datasets
  • Solid understanding of advanced statistics and machine learning practices.
  • Experience in one or more specialized machine learning areas (e.g., NLP, deep learning, recommendation systems, reinforcement learning)
  • Outstanding coding skills or software development background.
  • Ability to think independently and communicate complex ideas to less technical persons
  • Excellent command of English in both verbal and written forms

rows.title: Corporate Legal Manager
rows.description:
Responsibilities:

Corporate Legal

  • Lead and resolve legal disputes, including litigation, arbitration, and alternative dispute resolution processes, involving Zipcode and its affiliated entities.
  • Provide expert legal advice and guidance on all legal matters related to real estate investment activities, including acquisitions, dispositions, leasing, and development projects.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate business agreements or legal documents in both Thai and English including lease agreements, consulting contracts, employment contracts, etc.
  • Identify and mitigate legal risks associated with strategic initiatives and business operations.


Compliance & Policy

  • Monitor and ensure compliance with local, state, and federal laws and regulations affecting real estate operations, such as zoning laws, land use regulations, environmental laws, fair housing laws, and tax laws.
  • Develop and implement policies and procedures to enhance legal compliance and streamline legal processes within the organization.
  • Advise on corporate governance matters, including compliance with corporate policies, board governance, and shareholder relations.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards and best practices.


Due Diligence

  • Conduct thorough due diligence investigations for real estate transactions and business ventures undertaken by Zipcode and its affiliated companies.


Legal Administrative

  • Manage all legal matters and support legal administrative tasks related to the business of the Company and its affiliates.
  • Stay abreast of relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards affecting the real estate sector and affiliated businesses.
  • Perform other administrative tasks and duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Law.
  • 7 years of legal & compliance management required.
  • Experience in Real Estate Development is preferable.
  • Strong knowledge of corporate law, real estate law, including property rights, land use regulations, leasing, and financing.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (verbally and written)
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and management skills.
  • Excellent planning and organizational skills - for writing and monitoring legal schedules and utilizing time and resources effectively.
  • Self-driven, ability to work independently and manage productivity.
  • Strong attention to detail for conducting site inspections and managing complex contracts.
  • Ability to make decisions under pressure.

rows.title: Head of Leasing
rows.description:
Responsibilities:

Strategic Planning and Management

  • Develop and execute leasing strategies to achieve and exceed occupancy targets for commercial/residential properties.
  • Lead and analyze market trends to stay updated on industry trends, consumer preferences, and competitive landscapes.
  • Set annual leasing targets and budget forecasts in collaboration with the management team.
  • Oversee promotional campaigns to encourage customer spending and increase tenant sales.


Leasing Operations

  • Collaborate with marketing and property management teams to enhance property visibility and attract prospective tenants.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with tenants, brokers, and industry professionals.


Legal and Regulatory Compliance

  • Negotiate lease agreements, ensuring terms are favorable and align with company objectives.
  • Ensure compliance with leasing policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.


Financial Management

  • Setting rental rates and lease terms in consultation with stakeholders.
  • Monitoring and optimizing rental income, occupancy rates, and overall leasing performance with financial metrics to ensure targets are met.
  • Manage the Leasing budget, allocating resources effectively to maximize impact and achieve objectives.
  • Analyze leasing data and manage the Profit and Loss (P&L) statements for the properties.


People Management

  • Lead and manage a team of leasing professionals, providing guidance, coaching, and support to ensure leasing goals are met.
  • Foster a collaborative and results-driven team environment.
  • Perform other administrative tasks and duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Marketing, or related fields.
  • 7 years+ of experience in progressive experience in leasing management within the real estate industry.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, and research skills.
  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to draft and execute lease agreements.
  • Leadership skills and an ability to motivate your team to ensure a high standard of work.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage customers and build rapport effectively
  • Self-driven, ability to work independently and manage the productivity.
  • Ability to make decisions under pressure.
  • Positive attitude, enthusiasm, and a passion for delivering exceptional customer service.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

rows.title: Executive Assistant
rows.description:
Job Responsibilities:


  • Manage the Director's calendar, schedule appointments, and coordinate meetings.
  • Organize travel arrangements, including booking flights, accommodations, and transportation for the Director as needed.
  • Handle phone calls, emails, and inquiries with timely and professional responses.
  • Act as a liaison between the Director and internal staff, as well as external contacts, maintaining strong interpersonal relationships.
  • Prepare and edit correspondence, reports, and presentations on behalf of the Director ensuring accuracy and professionalism.
  • Distribute materials for meetings and presentations, ensuring that all necessary documents are prepared, organized, and available ahead of time.
  • Support the Director’s cultivation activities by serving a VIP liaison, ensuring a positive experience for guests and dignitaries.
  • Assist the Art Administrator in maintaining accurate and up-to-date databases, contact lists, and document archives.
  • Collaborate with human resources on the onboarding of new employees, ensuring a smooth transition and integration into the organization.
  • Assist the Art Administrator in organizing the library books and related materials, both physically and digitally.
  • Provide assistance for the Director’s guests and other VIPs visiting the museum and other Dib-associated companies.
  • Manage visitor access to our exhibitions and programs as needed.
  • Maintain a high level of confidentiality regarding sensitive information.
  • Perform other administrative duties and special projects as assigned by management.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, management, or related field preferred.
  • Fluency in Thai and English.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Previous experience in administrative support roles, preferably in an art-related or cultural organization.
  • Ability to multitask effectively.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact professionally with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for the arts and a commitment to supporting cultural enrichment of people is a plus.

rows.title: Web Programmer (Magento)
rows.description:
ลักษณะงาน


- มีประสบการณ์การพัฒนา ดูแล และจัดการเว็บด้วย Magento Framework

- สามารถพัฒนา web application ด้วยภาษา PHP ได้

- สามารถใช้งานฐานข้อมูล MySQL และ MS SQL Server ได้

- สามารถใช้งาน CSS, Bootstrap, Ajax, JavaScript, JQuery, JSON, XML และ Restful API

- เคยมีประสบการณ์การพัฒนา API - วิเคราะห์ปัญหา และแก้ไขปัญหาเบื้องต้นได้

- มีความรับผิดชอบสูง

- ชอบเรียนรู้เทคโนโลยีใหม่ ๆ

- สามารถทำงานเป็นทีมได้ คุณสมบัติเจาะจง อายุ(ปี) : ไม่เกิน 45 ปี

กรณีไม่มีประสบการณ์ ต้องเป็นคนเรียนรู้ไว้ ไม่ติดปัญหาในการเดินทางมาทำงาน และ ไม่ติดปัญหาเรื่องเวลาการทำงาน ขยัน ซื่อสัตย์ อดทนมีวินัย ตรงต่อเวลา ฉลาด คล่องแคล่ว สื่อสารกับบุคคลอื่นได้ดี สามารถร่วมงานกับผู้อื่นได้

มีความมุ่งมั่นที่จะเรียนรู้ เพื่อพัฒนาตัวเอง มีเป้าหมายที่จะเจริญเติบโตไปพร้อมๆ กับบริษัทฯ


คุณสมบัติ

- พัฒนา และดูแลเว็บไซต์ E-commerce รวมถึงระบบงาน Web Application ของบริษัท และบริษัทในเครือ

- พัฒนา และออกแบบเว็บไซต์เพื่อ support SEO

- พัฒนาเว็บไซต์เพื่อรองรับการใช้งานบนอุปกรณ์ต่าง ๆ ได้เป็นอย่างดี (Responsive)

- พัฒนาแผนและขั้นตอนตรวจสอบซอฟต์แวร์ เช่น Unit Testing

- ส่งมอบซอฟต์แวร์ที่มีคุณภาพและความปลอดภัย

- จัดเตรียมและติดตั้งโซลูชั่นสำหรับ Test Environment และ/หรือ โปรดักชั่น

- อัพเดทเทคโนโลยีต่างๆ รวมถึงดูแลและทำการติดตั้งอื่นๆ เช่น การทำ Deployment ให้ความช่วยเหลือแก่ผู้ใช้ แก้ปัญหาที่ได้รับ และจัดทำคู่มือใช้งาน

company.name: MK
company.introduction: MK Restaurants was the first suki chain to use electric suki pots at every table. Before MK, suki restaurants in Thailand used gas stoves which were dangerous and has been the cause of numerous explosions and fires around Thailand. MK also introduced an innovative serving plate called “condo” to alleviate the problem of limited table-top space. Condo plates can be stacked high to help free up table space.

rows.description:
Description:

การหาผู้ขายใหม่:

  • หาข้อมูลของผู้ขายรายใหม่
  • ขอเจรจาต่อรองราคาและเงื่อนไขการขาย

  • ประสานงานกับหน่วยงานผู้ขอซื้อ

  • ประสานงานกับหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้องในการรับและตรวจรับสินค้า

การพัฒนาผู้ขาย:

  • การประเมินผลผู้ขาย
  • เยี่ยมเยียนผู้ขาย

  • ดูแลระบบคุณภาพต่าง ๆ
  • บริหารบุคลากร
  • วางแผนและจัดทำงบประมาณประจำปี
  • เข้าร่วมกิจกรรมบริษัท ตามที่ได้รับมอบหมาย
  • อื่น ๆ ที่ได้รับมอบหมาย


Qualifications:

  • เพศชายหรือหญิง
  • อายุ 35 - 45 ปี สัญชาติไทย
  • วุฒิการวุฒิการศึกษา ปริญญาตรีขึ้นไป ไม่จำกัดสาขา
  • ประสบการณ์ทำงานด้านจัดซื้อ ไม่ต่ำกว่า 8 ปี เคยผ่านงานด้านจัดซื้อ

rows.title: Database Administrator Specialist
rows.description:
Job Descriptions:

  • Plans and coordinates the administration of RDBMS databases to ensure accurate, appropriate, and effective use of data, including database definition, structure, documentation and operational guidelines
  • Install, configure, upgrade and migrate the database server on On-premise and Cloud solution
  • Monitor database performance, identify problem and system performance tuning of database server
  • Responsible for improvement and maintenance of the databases to include rollout and upgrades
  • Responsible for implementation and release of database changes as submitted by the development team
  • Responsible for development scripts to maintain databases
  • Design and implement high availability and disaster recovery feature of database server
  • Design and implement data archiving policy and process
  • Design backup and recovery database policy and process
  • Develop SQL script, schema design, code review and SQL query tuning
  • Control access permission, privilege and security
  • Be available for on-call, e-mail support as needed


Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related fields
  • Experience in managing and maintaining SQL Server at large scale and advance feature
  • Knowledge in RDBMS Product or SQL language
  • Experience in SQL Server, MS SQL, MongoDB
  • Experience in Hive, Presto is a plus
  • Experience in UNIX and Windows operating system
  • Able to work overtime at customer sites
  • Able to work effectively both as part of a team
  • Positive attitude
  • Self-study from text document and able to adapt and learn under fast changing environment
  • Good personal skill for reading and speaking English. Chinese is a plus.

rows.title: Commercial Audit & Compliance
rows.description:
ROLE & RESPONSIBILITY

Part 1: Commercial Audit & Compliance 

  1. Regulatory Compliance: Understand and adhere to relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards related to commercial activities
  2. Policy Development: Develop, implement and update policy and procedure
  3. 3.Risk Assessment: Identify potential commercial compliance risk and assess potential impact and develop strategy to mitigate risk
  4. Monitoring and Auditing: Monitor commercial operations to ensure compliance and conduct internal commercial audit and identify any compliance issues
  5. Reporting and Documentation: Maintain documentation related to compliance activities
  6. Internal Control: Establish and maintain effective internal controls to prevent and detect compliance violations, e.g. segregation of duties, authorization procedure, etc.
  7. Investigation & Remediation: Investigate any compliance issues, misconduct and recommend appropriate corrective actions

Part 2: Counterpart Registration (KYC)

  1. Data Collection: Gather essential information from potential customers
  2. Pre-screening: Preliminarily assess the credibility of potential customers
  3. Commercial Evaluation: Develop commercial criteria to evaluate potential customers
  4. Documentation: Review customer’s information and ensure completeness
  5. Customer Due Diligence: Assist in due diligence process
  6. Account Setup: Complete the process if approved by authorized bodies
  7. Ongoing Monitoring & Review & Report: Monitor customer accounts and report any suspicious activities, change in risk profile, or potential illicit activities


EDUCATION

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Political Science, Business administration or related field


EXPERIENCE

  • At least 3-5 years experience in audit field, regulatory compliance, risk management and control in Petroleum & Petrochemical business or related
  • Excellent knowledge of general tools and techniques of audit & compliance
  • Ability to think intuitively and strategically in order to mitigate compliance risk
  • Excellence in writen and interpersonal skills in dealing with people
  • Strong communication skill, negotiating skill, and consulting skill

Lead the technical conversations with customers to drive value from their MS investments. Deliver all work according to MS best practices & policies and using repeatable IP.

rows.title: Information Technology Auditor
rows.description:
Job Description

  • Assist IT Audit Leader in performing an independent assessment on inherent risk and control risk of the company’s information systems in order to develop the annual risk-based IT audit plan
  • Gather data from the monthly incident report and perform preliminary review to identify and prioritize risks and key controls over the information systems under review for audit project planning purpose.
  • Develop Audit Planning Memorandum (APM) to identify the audit objective, scope of review, audit approach, audit timeline, audit team member and expected controls and communicate the APM to Head of process under review in the opening meeting.
  • Execute the IT audit engagement to evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of IT general controls and application controls; including IT policies/procedures, logical access controls, system development, change management and computer operation.
  • Conduct cyber security review, penetration testing at network, web application and mobile application
  • Provide an advisory service on IT security and controls in relation to digital and infrastructure technology to ensure IT security and controls are appropriately designed.
  • Develop clear, concise and understandable working paper to document work performed.
  • Support and assist Operational and Subsidiary audit engagements.
  • Identify control weaknesses and non-compliance to company's policies, procedures and related regulations, which may result in ineffective and inefficient operations.
  • Prepare Issue Log and participate the Closing meeting to obtain agreement on the results of the audit and management action plan for remediation action and controls improvement actions (detective / preventive controls).
  • Provide oral or written presentations to management during the audit and at the conclusion of each audit or special project.
  • Prepare formal written reports for each audit project expressing an opinion on the adequacy of the internal control structure.
  • Follow-up on the status of remediation action and controls improvement action from management in order to ensure management action is taken in a timely manner.
  • Gather the Post Audit Survey result from key customers after audit engagement completion and make an improvement on suggestion provided by key customers to achieve customer’s requirements and to improve an effectiveness and efficiency of audit work.
  • Perform ad-hoc assignments or any other special requests from management.
  • Coordinate with BAY internal auditors to provide optimal audit coverage to the company.


Qualifications:

  • Thai Nationality.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, MIS, AIS or IT related fields
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in internal or external IT audit, IT/Cyber security, Network security or related fields, preferably in Finance & Banking business
  • Knowledge of IT processes, IT risks, IT security and IT technical knowledge (e.g. network/web application/mobile application penetration testing, network/operating system/database configuration and security review)
  • Familiarity with leading standards/practices (e.g. COBIT, ITIL, ISO27001, PCI-DSS, OWASP) and compliance regulations (e.g. BOT, OIC)
  • Through understanding of audit concept and process
  • IT General controls (e.g., Systems development, Change management, Security, Computer operations) and Application controls (e.g., source data control, input validation routines, data processing and file maintenance controls, output controls
  • Credit card, personal loan and insurance broker product & related business process knowledge

ASP is a global leader in infection prevention solutions for healthcare. With advanced products, technologies, and workflows for medical sterilization and disinfection, ASP is dedicated to defending the lives of patients, families, healthcare workers, providers, and communities.


Add your voice and talents to our extraordinary Fortive/ASP team, and help us make healthcare safer for everyone.

rows.title: (Sr) Product Sales Representative
rows.description:
Your Impact

  • Increase ASP’s product footprint in assigned territory in a manner consistent with company goals.
  • Establish relationships with new and targeted existing customers and identify solutions to meet customer needs through consultative selling process.
  • Provide customers with the appropriate solutions, marketing collateral, and clinical information to obtain customer commitment to purchase ASP products.
  • Develop new potential customers, primarily via Capital equipment placements while developing customer champions for ASP technologies.
  • Effectively communicate and collaborate with: Regional Sales Manager, field service engineers, marketing, training and education.
  • Provide product demonstration, training presentations and in-servicing based upon Customer’s needs.
  • Leverage Salesforce.com to provide timely and current information on customers within your territory; routinely update sales actions plans and forecasts for Territory Quarterly Reviews and Business Plans to facilitate the purchase of ASP products and services.
  • Establish and maintain optimum account call frequencies which lead to better relationships with the customer, better understanding of the customer’s business and needs, and the accomplishment of the sales quota.
  • Analyze territory capital, consumable, and service sales potential to develop sales execution plans that maximizes sales at or in excess of the company plan.
  • Continually acquire, maintain, and expand personal understanding of features, benefits, applications and market conditions, which enhance the needs for our current and future products.
  • Participate in local Chapters or other relevant organizations including regional level buying groups.
  • Responsible for communicating business related issues or opportunities to next management level.
  • Performs other duties assigned as needed.


Our Needs

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in medical sales, preferably capital equipment, or equivalent experience.
  • The ability to travel based on the requirements of the role.
  • Experience prospecting for new business and cold calling.
  • Demonstrated/documented success launching new products, increasing product utilization, and protecting business from competition.
  • Experience discussing reimbursement related to medical device sales.
  • Experience selling to ASC’s, and Inpatient/Outpatient Endoscopy Suites.
  • Sterilization experience strongly preferred.

rows.title: Solutions Architect
rows.description:
Responsibilities

  • Develop reusable API modules and detailed API specifications to facilitate efficient data exchange.
  • Create optimized database schemas and OpenEHR templates to support complex data structures within healthcare applications.
  • Utilize domain-driven design principles to define clear software domain boundaries and design RESTful API architectures.
  • Estimate high-level effort required for feature completion, aiding in project planning and resource allocation.
  • Design comprehensive software architectures that address product goals, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Craft deployment diagrams that adhere to security best practices, ensuring robust defense mechanisms are integrated into software deployments.
  • Regularly collect and integrate feedback from stakeholders on the solution design to ensure continuous improvement of the system.
  • Work closely with Business Analysts (BAs) to translate user requirements into ubiquitous language, ensuring consistency from user stories to implementation.
  • Partner with Staff Engineers to ensure that code designs align with the overall software architecture.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineers to ensure that the software architecture is implemented according to design.
  • Design and conduct proofs of concept (PoCs) for new technologies, assessing their potential integration into our tech stack based on development ease, operational complexity, security, performance, cost, and developer experience.
  • Regularly present architecture updates to both the product team and management to align on progress and strategic direction.
  • Define specifications for migrating data from legacy systems to new applications and for data interfaces between applications.
  • Evaluate and document the existing IT infrastructure of customers as a foundational step for implementing Cortex, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of current capabilities and requirements.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts to analyze customer workflows and gather detailed requirements, aiming to bridge any technological gaps and enhance workflow efficiency through feasible solutions.


Technology Stack Skills

  • Azure Cloud, Multi Cloud, VmWare Hybrid Cloud
  • TypeScript or GoLang
  • SQL server, Kafka, Redis
  • Terraform, Github Actions, ArgoCD
  • Kubernetes & Service Mesh
  • Elastic stack, Promotheus, Grafana


Qualifications

  • Minimum Bachelor's degree in related field
  • Proven minimum 3 years' experience in relevant role or industry
  • Proven ability to lead and manage complex micro-service software.
  • Proven ability to develop standard software pattern for complex software system.
  • In-depth knowledge of healthcare industry standards, regulations, and best practices.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in FHIR persistence technology
  • Experience in OpenEHR technology
  • Experience in Camunda Platform
  • Experience in Terminology server for example FHIR Terminology server, Ontoserver or Snowstorm.

rows.title: Sourcing Specialist
rows.description:
1. Job Purpose:

The Sourcing and Supply Chain Manager is responsible for assessing and negotiating with existing and new suppliers, managing purchase requisitions and orders, and ensuring accurate cost and product codes. This role involves coordinating with established vendors, searching for new suppliers locally and internationally, and establishing strong supplier relationships. The manager must understand the supply market to ensure efficient management and meet operational needs.


2. Main Responsibilities:

  • Sourcing Solutions: Provide effective sourcing solutions to meet brand requirements.
  • Daily Operations Management: Oversee daily operations including delivery coordination, price/cost analysis, contract negotiation, policy and procedure compliance, and logistical coordination. Serve as a liaison to other company functions.
  • Demand and Supply Management: Ensure accurate demand forecasting and reliable supply for short, medium, and long-term needs.
  • Raw Material Procurement: Manage the procurement of raw materials and develop new products according to the Marketing Calendar, ensuring timely product launches with no supply disruptions.
  • Customer Interaction: Regularly interact with in-house customers to achieve cooperative strategies.
  • Supplier Relationship Management: Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships.
  • Supply Planning: Plan and manage supply levels to maintain adequate stock while minimizing excess inventory.
  • Cost Negotiation: Negotiate with suppliers focusing on total cost rather than just price.
  • Supplier Sourcing: Identify and evaluate new potential suppliers to reduce product costs.
  • Additional Duties: Perform other tasks as assigned by the supervisor.


Other Duties:

  • Compliance: Adhere to company rules and regulations.
  • Training and Participation: Attend and contribute to training sessions, meetings, and other required activities.
  • Representation: Represent the company positively and maintain professional relationships with business partners.
  • Office Maintenance: Ensure high standards of personal presentation and office cleanliness.
  • Flexibility: Be prepared to work on holidays and weekends as needed and carry out any other reasonable duties as assigned.


3. Job Profile:

  • Work Schedule: Flexible hours, typically five days a week.
  • Task Management: Handle multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Work Environment: Work under time pressure with minimal supervision, manage large volumes of data, documents, and reports.
  • Flexibility: Available for work on holidays and weekends as necessary.
  • Process Improvement: Continuously improve working processes.
  • Communication: Frequent use of English and computer programs.
  • Stakeholder Liaison: Regularly liaise with various stakeholders, including Marketing, Operations, HR, Accounting, Logistics, and QA.
  • Location: Primarily based in Bangkok with occasional travel to stores and supplier sites as needed.
  • Role: Act as a business owner, stand by for critical supply chain issues, and be a trusted partner to brands, suppliers, and third-party logistics (3PL) providers.


Qualifications:

  • Skills: Strong drive for results, excellent interpersonal and outgoing communication skills, proficiency in English, and computer literacy.
  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of direct experience in purchasing within the food industry.

rows.title: Category Manager
rows.description:
Job Description

Overall Purpose:

The Category Manager will report directly to the Sr. Manager – Direct Sourcing, Supply Chain Management Hotel, and play a crucial role in supporting project-related initiatives across hotel operations. This hands-on position requires managing large and/or multiple projects efficiently, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to specified standards. The role involves extensive project management, supplier influence, and collaboration with various internal departments to enhance operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness. The Category Manager will also be responsible for contract management, analytical reporting, and executive communications.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Supply Chain Processes: Design and align new supply chain demand processes and policies with existing business processes.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Develop strategic sourcing strategies for assigned categories.
  • Supplier Relationships: Build and maintain long-term relationships with key strategic partners.
  • Cost Savings: Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities through global, regional, and local sourcing, substitute products, and product engineering.
  • Reporting: Prepare reports and documentation for various initiatives and projects.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with SCM-Hotel Risk Management, SCM-Hotel QA, SCM-Hotel Operations, and properties to ensure smooth operations.
  • Project Management: Independently lead a team in managing all aspects of project management, including planning, execution, and completion of multiple projects.
  • Operational Strategy: Lead discrete supply chain projects related to operational strategy, planning, and execution.
  • Supplier Evaluation: Analyze and recommend suppliers' bids, proposals, and contracts through category analysis and supplier meetings.
  • Product Rollouts: Facilitate timely new product rollouts or modifications.
  • Contract Management: Manage supply contracts and develop contingency plans for core products.
  • Coaching: Provide coaching and teaching to direct reports.


Qualifications:

  • Education:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • Experience:
  • Experience in forecasting within a consumer products environment using Oracle-based products.
  • Significant background in Supply Chain Management with exposure to various aspects.
  • Skills:
  • Strong system and analytical skills with advanced proficiency in Excel (e.g., v-lookups, pivot tables) and familiarity with MS Access / Oracle Data Warehouse.
  • Ability to extract and compile data from multiple systems and make informed recommendations.
  • Proven problem-solving skills, capable of dealing with concrete variables and interpreting diverse instructions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams through new business processes and manage large-scale projects effectively.
  • Excellent oral, written, and presentation skills.
  • Flexible and responsive to change.

rows.title: Sustainability Manager – Occupational Health and safety
rows.description:
Job Purpose:

The Sustainability Manager will enhance the company's occupational health and safety (OHS) performance, aligning with national and international laws and regulations. This role involves engaging internal and external stakeholders to meet the company’s long-term goals, particularly focusing on the safety and well-being of employees. The role also includes collaborating with the senior sustainability manager to elevate the OHS performance of upstream supply chain suppliers through education, assessment, and audits, supporting the company’s sustainability objectives.


Main Responsibilities:

In-House Implementation of Occupational Health and Safety:

﻿2. Main Responsibilities:

  • Monitors, tracks and reviews contract and agreement documents, and notifies regarding required adjustments.
  • Reviews and provides recommendations to the team on all formal solicitations. Assists in writing specifications for goods, scope of work for services. Ensure appropriate performance standards, quality, delivery, life cycle cost and warranty are identified in formal one and two step solicitations.

  • Provides assistance with the formal bid process for specialized equipment and services. Process reports as required.

  • Makes operation staff and/or all relevant parties aware of contract requirement and monitor compliance
  • Ensures all financial and contract issues are properly completed at the close out of contracts
  • Maintains contractual records and documentation such as receipt and control of all contract correspondence, supplier contact information sheets, contractual changes, status reports and other documents for all projects as well as Tracks saving, rebate and/or support which are aligned with the contracts
  • Monitors compliance with established procedures. Identify areas of recurrent pressure.
  • Ensures contract close-out, extension or renewal

  • Attend and contribute to all training sessions, meetings and activities as required.
  • Exercises responsible behaviour at all times, positively representing MINT.
  • Maintains strong, professional relationship with relevant business partners.
  • Ensure high standards of personal presentation and grooming.
  • Keep the office and working areas clean and tidy at all times.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.


Qualifications

  • Strategic thinking ability, with strong leadership and hyper-collaboration skills
  • Strong experience in contract management and end-to-end supply chain execution.
  • Strong knowledge of supply chain management principles, practices and procedures preferred, as well as experience with supply system.
  • Experienced in Food and Non-Food manufacturing process from upstream (raw material) to downstream (processing), Hotel Business or Share Services
  • Strong in people development
  • Strong project management and execution skill.
  • Good command of English and computer literacy.

Lead and develop methods for delivery of data in formats required by customers.

rows.description:

  • เคลื่อนย้าย, ตรวจสอบ และเทวัตถุดิบตามขั้นตอนทำงาน (WI)
  • จัดการของเสียที่เกิดการกระบวนการผลิตรวมทั้งน้ำเสียที่เกิดจากกระบวนการผลิตตามขั้นตอนการทำงานที่กำหนดไว้
  • ดูแลความสะอาดของเครื่องจักร และพื้นที่การทำงานโดยผ่านกิจกรรม 5ส.
  • ดูแลและซ่อมบำรุงเครื่องจักรเบื่องต้นให้พร้อมใช้งานอยู่เสมอโดยผ่านกิจกรรม TPM
  • เขียนรายงานการปฏิบัติงานและปัญหาการผลิตประจำวัน เพื่อแจ้งให้ Shift leader และกะต่อไปให้รับทราบ
  • อบรมและสาธิตการปฏิบัติงานให้กับพนักงานใหม่ให้รู้ขั้นตอนการผลิต และความปลอดภัยในการปฏิบัติงานตามที่Shift leader มอบหมาย
  • ปฏิบัติงานตามข้อกำหนดของ ISO 9001, ISO 14001, SHE std. และข้อกำหนดอื่นๆที่บริษัทกำหนดไว้
  • ปฏิบัติงานอื่นๆตามที่ได้รับมอบหมายจาก Shift leader หรือ Production supervisor.


ต้องการทักษะและประสบการณ์

  • 1 – 2 ปีในฝ่ายผลิต (ทางด้าน Chemical Plant).
  • มีความขยัน อดทน มีภาวะผู้นำ


คุณสมบัติ

  • ปวส. สาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง หากมีประสบการณ์ทำงานในโรงงานผลิตผลิตสารเคมี จะได้รับการพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ

rows.description:

  • จัดเก็บสินค้าและวัตถุดิบ ตามขั้นตอนการปฏิบัติงาน
  • เตรียมวัตถุดิบและสินค้าเพื่อใช้ในการผลิต ตามขั้นตอนการปฏิบัติงาน
  • เตรียมวัตถุดิบและสินค้าเพื่อจัดส่งสินค้าให้ลูกค้า ตามขั้นตอนการปฏิบัติงาน
  • ตรวจสอบพื้นที่ปฏิบัติงานให้มีความเรียบร้อยและรายงานเมื่อพบสิ่งผิดปกติ
  • บำรุงรักษาเครื่องมือและอุปกรณ์ที่ใช้ปฏิบัติงานในคลังสินค้าให้อยู่ในสภาพพร้อมใช้งานและมีความปลอดภัย สนับสนุนนโยบายของบริษัทฯ เพื่อให้บรรลุตามวัตถุประสงค์ เช่น ระบบคุณภาพ (ISO 9001) และ ระบบการดูแล ด้วยความรับผิดชอบ (RC 14001) และในกรณีที่บริษัทฯ นำระบบการจัดการด้านความปลอดภัย (OHSAS 18001)


ต้องการทักษะและประสบการณ์

  • เคยผ่านการทำงานในโรงงานอุตสาหกรรมอย่างน้อย 1 ปี
  • สามารถขับรถฟอร์คลิฟท์ได้


คุณสมบัติ

  • จบการศึกษาระดับ ม. 6 หรือผู้มีประสบการณ์การทำงานในคลังสินค้าอย่างน้อย 2-3 ปี
  • ผ่านการอบรมการดับเพลิงขั้นพื้นฐาน
  • ผ่านการอบรมการขับรถฟอร์คลิฟท์

What You'll Do

  • Own, maintain, and upgrade the marketing technology stack
  • Manage and optimize the Customer Data Platform to ensure efficient data collection and activation. Manage data sources and destinations to ensure comprehensive data coverage.
  • Integrate CDP with various marketing tools to ensure seamless data flow. Oversee the setup and maintenance of marketing automation platforms (e.g., Braze, Liveramp)
  • Ensure data is collected from all relevant sources and properly routed to appropriate destinations for analysis and action
  • Ensure these platforms are effectively integrated with other internal systems and data warehouses to support marketing campaigns and initiatives
  • Define principles for defining the broader taxonomy for events (and properties) and user attributes/traits for marketing communications
  • Review, approve, audit, and clean up events & attributes on an ongoing basis to adhere to principles and keep within data usage limits
  • Plan and execute timely upgrades to SDKs, ensuring compatibility with current systems and minimal disruption to business operations
  • Web marketing / Ad platform integration for spend optimization
  • Integrate with ad platforms (Google, Meta, TikTok, affiliate networks, etc.) via APIs to onboard new channels, optimize ad campaigns, and enable retargeting. Exchange data and smart signals with ad platforms to enhance ad performance
  • Implement API integrations to extract and clean campaign, keyword, etc data from ad channels for comprehensive reporting to optimize spend and improve ROAS
  • Facilitate web marketing initiatives and help improve SEO performance
  • Produce and maintain high-quality data and pipelines
  • Develop and maintain marketing data pipelines, ETL processes, and data integration workflows to ensure efficient and accurate data acquisition from various internal & external sources using SQL, Python, or other scripting languages
  • Design, build, and optimize data architecture & models to support marketing reporting and analytics needs. Understand evolving business requirements to optimize/update data pipelines
  • Ensure all marketing data and attributes are of high quality, operationally reliable, strongly governed, and well documented by using in-house tools and monitoring systems
  • Be a data and functional expert at EarnIn
  • Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies in the field of marketing
  • Be a data SME related to the marketing domain
  • Identify and recommend new growth opportunities within existing and newer marketing channels by analyzing data and leveraging the latest technology


What We're Looking For

  • Bachelors in Engineering/ Business/ Analytics or a related field
  • 4+ years of experience in the analytics space
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python
  • Familiarity with business intelligence tools like Tableau
  • Knowledge of Customer Data Platforms and marketing automation tools like Braze, Liveramp
  • Knowledge of API integrations with ad platforms (Google, Meta, TikTok) and data extraction for reporting and optimization
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, collaboration, and organizational skills Ability to analyze data to drive business decisions
  • Technically conversant and forward-thinking in areas of channel activation, orchestration, AI, and marketing optimization
  • Experience working with vendors preferred
  • Marketing domain knowledge is strongly preferred
